caption:
Lost game one 11-21. Then she switched it on.

Tanvi Sharma, 17, came back to beat fellow Indian Unnati Hooda 11-21, 21-10, 21-13 in the Syed Modi International semi-finals in Lucknow today. After losing the opener, she let Unnati score only 23 points in the next two games.

A year ago Tanvi went out in the semi-finals of this same event. In August she won the Taipei Open Super 300. Now she is into her first Syed Modi final.

Sunday's final is against Thailand's Supanida Katethong. Tanvi is the second seed and the winner takes home US$18,750.

Can a 17-year-old win a Super 300 title at home? Tell us below.

Match scores via Maalaimalar. Result also reported by Amar Ujala.
